modalities.evidence: pre-operative T1, T1-CE, and T2-FLAIR MR images
Clinical information includes grade, subtype, type of surgery

output.population: 96 consecutive treatment naïve patients with intracranial meningiomas treated with surgical resection from 2010 to 2019
output.summary: Pre-operative T1, T1-contrast-enhanced, and T2-FLAIR MRI from treatment-naive patients with intracranial meningiomas who underwent surgical resection, with manual tumor contours and clinical information including confirmed grade and subtype.
